notes.chin: frame 7's first row under the jaw
notes.bob: the drawn one (the head where each frame drew its own, the jaw on the drawn jaw)
notes.variants: char: head_match_colours = her eye white and skin (the columns), chin_rows = each frame's jaw row (the lowest skin row of the face's right part: a bare neck shows under its left) with head_align chin (the rows); clear_all, clear_grow 3 (the drawn tails reach up to 3 squares past frame 7's); keep_colours = the fur collar and the orange scarf; beside_head ground (what the drawn heads leave beside the laid one is ground - filled from the colours round it, the fur collar grew into the strands' place); the head's lower left stops where frame 7's own dark shadow would come out thicker than the outline (the outline pass took 6-10 squares off it in every other frame)
